listing.name: Spider-Man: Web of Shadows — WebOfShadowsRecomp (toowasmir)
listing.summary: The project describes native-port features. The reviewed README does not establish full-game completion. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Xbox 360 game for title 41560815, including default.xex and the required pak and bik assets. The reviewed README does not specify the supported region, revision or media ID; check the project’s requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the v2.0.4 native executable and launcher to extract your own ISO. Alternatively, build from source with VS2022 Clang, CMake, Ninja and ReXGlue. The player requires x64 with AVX2, FMA3 and D3D12.

warnings: The project describes native-port features. The reviewed README does not establish full-game completion.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
